title: Side nav
summary: The app’s side navigation: brand, filter box, nested groups with arrow-key tree navigation, collapse to an icon rail (tooltips on rows, branches open as flyouts), persisted state, and an off-canvas drawer with backdrop at 1024px and below.

props.name: persist
props.description: localStorage key for collapsed and open branches.

props.name: currentPath
props.description: The host's current URL path. When set, resolves the deepest-matching pk-nav-item (by href) and sets its `current`, clearing every other row; see resolveActiveRoute in nav-logic.js for the algorithm.

props.name: autoExpandActive
props.description: With current-path, also opens every ancestor branch of the active row and collapses every other branch.

slots.description: pk-nav-item children; a pk-nav-item with the group attribute is a group title.

events.name: pk-nav-toggle
events.description: Rail toggled by the user, or restored from the saved state (persist) on connect.

writes.why: rail is pushed down to the top-level rows (children in a flyout keep their labels) whenever the collapsed state or the breakpoint changes (an item cannot know it); the filter box sets hidden on rows that do not match and expanded on the parents of a match, and restores the expanded state when the box is cleared; keyboard navigation sets expanded or flyout on the focused row. The one pair of elements whose props are written by the parent. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: A nav landmark; branches are buttons with aria-expanded; Up/Down move between rows, Right opens or enters a branch, Left folds or goes up, Home/End jump; the filter announces its result count; the drawer hides from assistive tech when closed and returns focus to its opener.
mobile: A drawer at most 88vw wide, hidden from tab order while closed; rows are 44px.
